text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- There has been a tenfold increase in child abuse reports over 10 years. The rise could be due in part to heightened awareness. There were 500 child abuse cases reported between November 1994 and last June.
- Man charged with wife's killing has attempted suicide.
- Italian singer Ivana Spagna is in Malta to give a concert on Wednesday as guest of the General Workers Unions.
